description: Spawns a burst of particles at Location with the selected count, spread, and speed. Does not apply entity damage.
examples: Connect Flow, choose a particle, and provide the burst location and size.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts Spawn Particle Burst when execution reaches this input.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: World position for the effect or search. If omitted, uses the event location or current player location when available.

inputs.name: particle
inputs.description: Selects the Minecraft particle type.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Sets the number of particles to spawn.

inputs.name: spread
inputs.description: Sets the burst spread.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Sets the particle motion speed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after this effect or query returns. A cooldown branch, when present, bypasses this output.

description: Spawns particles in the selected burst, ring, line, or orbit arrangement around Location.
examples: Connect Flow, choose a shape, and provide the particle location and size.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts Particle Shape when execution reaches this input.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: World position for the effect or search. If omitted, uses the event location or current player location when available.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Chooses the particle shape.

inputs.name: particle
inputs.description: Selects the Minecraft particle type.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Sets the number of particles to spawn.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Burst spread, Ring or Orbit radius, or half the Line length, in blocks. Accepts 0 through 128.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Sets the particle motion speed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after this effect or query returns. A cooldown branch, when present, bypasses this output.

description: Reads an ability cooldown by key and scope. Ready runs when no time remains. Cooldown runs otherwise. Each tick is 50 milliseconds.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the cooldown key and scope, then branch on Ready or Cooldown.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts Cooldown Remaining when execution reaches this input.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the cooldown to read.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Chooses which owner shares the cooldown.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Stable ID of the custom-content definition to match or trigger.

outputs.name: ready
outputs.description: Runs when no cooldown time remains. Cooldown is skipped.

outputs.name: cooldown
outputs.description: Runs while time remains on the cooldown. Ready is skipped.

outputs.name: ticks
outputs.description: Remaining cooldown rounded up to ticks, using 50 milliseconds per tick.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: Remaining cooldown in seconds, including a fractional part.

outputs.name: duration_ticks
outputs.description: Configured cooldown duration rounded up to ticks, using 50 milliseconds per tick.

outputs.name: elapsed_ticks
outputs.description: Elapsed cooldown time rounded down to ticks, using 50 milliseconds per tick.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Elapsed fraction of the cooldown from 0 through 1. One means ready.

outputs.name: progress_percent
outputs.description: Elapsed percentage of the cooldown from 0 through 100.

outputs.name: started_at
outputs.description: Cooldown start as Unix epoch milliseconds.

outputs.name: ready_at
outputs.description: Cooldown expiry as Unix epoch milliseconds.

outputs.name: is_ready
outputs.description: True when no cooldown time remains.

description: Starts or replaces an ability cooldown for the given key and scope. Ticks accepts 0 through 72000, at 50 milliseconds per tick. Zero makes the cooldown ready.
examples: Connect Flow, choose the cooldown key and scope, and set its duration in ticks.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts Set Cooldown when execution reaches this input.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the cooldown to start.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Chooses which owner shares the cooldown.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Stable ID of the custom-content definition to match or trigger.

inputs.name: ticks
inputs.description: Sets the cooldown duration in server ticks.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after this effect or query returns. A cooldown branch, when present, bypasses this output.
